answer.reason: Two events belong to Siloam: the blind man was healed after washing there, and a tower fell there and killed eighteen.

clauses.english: was where a blind man washed at Jesus' word and received sight
clauses.quote: I went and washed, and I received sight

clauses.english: was where a tower fell and killed eighteen people
clauses.quote: the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them

doubts: NEH 2:14 names the king's pool, which may not be the same pool as Siloam, so it was left out.
NEH 3:15 only places the wall of the pool, so it adds nothing beyond the summary.
